limitations: The move record exposes type, power, accuracy, PP, priority, effect ID, secondary-effect chance, target and flags, but not a self-describing physical/special category label.
Move categories remain the pinned mainline fallback unless independently documented; ROM power 0 and 1 are represented as non-literal variable/status power.
